bottleneck_description: The technical API and data ingestion pipeline are fully functional (100% path verified). Synthetic fixtures are isolated in unit tests and not counted as real-world dataset records.
recommendations: Distribute public beta developer portal link to external developers for organic prompt testing
Maintain strict consent (consent = True) requirement without fallback defaults
Keep synthetic fixtures restricted to unit test suites
